entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: Former capital of the Sun Empire on Ixalan, most populous city-state, which survived the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city, first capital, to which the emperor returned the throne.

entities.name: Tocatli
entities.description: The emperor's fortified citadel at the heart of Pachatupa.

entities.name: Threefold Sun
entities.description: Sun deity of three aspects: Kinjalli, Tilonalli and Ixalli.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Pachatupa was besieged.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Pachatupa fills with refugees and peasant levies and the emperor's guards fight the Phyrexian horde; the city survives.
events.quote: Pachatupa — and to an extent, the Sun Empire — survived the invasion.

events.summary: After the invasion the emperor returns the throne to Orazca, moving the capital.
events.quote: The emperor returned the throne to Orazca, the first capital of the Sun Empire

relations.quote: is a glorious, fortified palace at the heart of Pachatupa
